operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: stop writes, export a complete installation archive, retain the exact source revision, restore into a fresh empty installation, establish fresh owner authority and compare stock, reservations, documents and audit before resuming. Keep applied migration names and bytes unchanged; reconnect external providers explicitly.
